basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old movie buff based in Mumbai, India. By day, I work as a digital marketing specialist for a startup, and in my free time, I love diving into the world of Bollywood and exploring the benefits of essential oils. I'm currently single, and I usually browse Reddit late at night, around 10 PM to 1 AM IST, when I have some downtime. I'm not a fan of overly negative spaces, so I seek out communities that offer constructive dialogue or entertainment.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in mass communication, which has fueled my passion for media and entertainment. My expertise lies in digital marketing strategies, acquired through both formal education and self-study. I have a keen interest in natural wellness, particularly essential oils, which I explore as a hobby.
